prompt:
Use case: style-transfer / ui-mockup edit.
Input image: edit target, the finished 05 像素夜港 UI art direction board for 港口装箱.
User request: "在这个像素风格的基础上，把整体都稍微扁平化一点" — make the WHOLE existing pixel style a little flatter. This is a moderate visual refinement, not a new direction or layout redesign.
Keep the entire complete landscape board: heading, 3 portrait screens (global/home, gameplay, level selection), right-hand UI component column. Preserve all screen positions, all functionalities, compositions, Chinese wording, and nocturnal harbor identity. Same beautiful indigo/plum/teal palette, amber lights and pixel sunset. Keep the original dimensional hierarchy and recognizability while giving everything a cleaner flatter sprite illustration treatment.
Apply the refinement consistently across ALL screens, scene art, cargo, title, boats, level markers, dialogs, buttons and components:
- Remove chunky glossy/chrome beveled UI rims, bright specular streaks and thick extruded button bases. Use flat solid-color pixel rectangles, clean stepped corners and a single thin pixel outline, with at most a very short one-pixel shadow for separation.
- Crates should become front-facing flat pixel squares, matte solid color with at most two restrained shade levels. Remove screw/rivet highlights, bulbous rim details, shiny bevels and thick side faces. Red vertical white stripes, blue white dots and green white diagonal slashes stay bold and instantly legible.
- Simplify boats, cranes, buildings, docks, buoys and quay platforms into coherent colored pixel shapes. Reduce depth of projecting edges, heavy cast shadows, stone microtexture and scattered shiny speckles by about one third. Keep attractive recognizable harbor illustration and layered distance, do not erase the setting or turn it into a wireframe.
- Water and sky retain crisp pixel clusters and warm lit reflections, but use calmer wider color clusters, fewer high-contrast glitter pixels, less bloom, softer value differences. Maintain warm/cool atmosphere without glossy realism.
- Title and UI numbers keep their bold pixel typography, with much less raised/extruded shadow. Dialog backgrounds are quiet flat navy rectangles and crisp modest pixel borders. No pill buttons, no smooth vector-looking curves, no blurry antialiasing, no 3D/PBR material.
- Flatten selected-level platform and other markers' excessive perspective thickness. Keep the arrangement and all ten numbered positions. Selected 06 distinguished by a flat amber outline/color block, not excessive glowing depth.
IMPORTANT: do not overflatten into sterile minimalist infographic, do not change it to the white modernist direction. Pixel scene art still detailed enough to be charming. Aim for 30–40% less visual depth and surface noise overall, with particularly clean flat UI.
Invariants that must remain EXACT:
Gameplay has three stacks of three boxes, from BOTTOM to TOP: left R,R,B; middle B,R,G; right G,G,B. Current red striped ship progress 0 / 3. Next ships ONE blue dotted icon ×3, then ONE green slash icon ×3. Exactly THREE empty temporary slots with ONE shared label 暂存 0 / 3. Initial 撤销 is disabled, 提示 shows 免费1次. Preserve settings and 船队 controls.

Success dialog 装船完成 has 下一关 and 重玩本关.
Blocked dialog 暂存已满 says 试试撤销，换一个取箱顺序, with 撤销 primary and 重新开始 secondary.

Heading remain "05 / 像素夜港"; subtitle change to "港口装箱 · 轻扁平版". Preserve full board aspect ratio and edge margins; no crop. Deliver polished high fidelity, sharp readable Chinese.
